Proof in the paper: XRD analysis implied that FeNi alloy phase was successfully generated in the FeNi/N-C-800 electrocatalyst, as verified by the appearance of three characteristic peaks at 43.6°, 50.8° and 74.7° (Fig. 2a), which can be assigned to the (111), (200) and (220) planes of FeNi alloy (JCPDS, PDF 47–1405).
